scope: All 263 retained failures from the retirement audit; no further removals or skips.

product_changes.behavior: Permission denial during virtual path resolution is retained as a named incomplete-read warning. Ambiguous paths still refuse.
Filename fields parse Bethesda virtual paths, so Linux responses contain the leaf filename rather than the full backslash path.

limits: Windows execution was not performed; the target for these repairs is Linux/Amethyst.

Fixture code changes and restored test coverage are distinguished from product changes above. Passing the suite alone does not complete separate release-environment validation.
Raw logs/TRX remain private because they contain machine-specific paths; public evidence uses hashes, outcomes and repository-relative links.

cases.resolution_kind: Linux replacement of a platform-specific expectation
cases.reason: The Linux installer uses its own activation lock rather than Windows DLL sharing denial. A locked upgrade refuses before replacing the active version; all prior version bytes, activation and host configuration remain unchanged.
